query:
SELECT state, district, candidate1, candidate2, status, rating, primary_date, general_date 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
UNION ALL
SELECT state, district, candidate1, candidate2, status, rating, primary_date, general_date 
FROM house_races 
WHERE state IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
ORDER BY state, district;
